Subject: Request to split MSA redline + vendor onboarding into two chunks

Hi Dylan,

Quick note from procurement/legal at Skyline — our GC has asked for a focused redline review with our counsel before the wider onboarding session. Can we split the session into: (1) a 30-minute MSA redline review with our counsel and Redwood legal, and (2) a 60-minute vendor onboarding/checklist run-through with our procurement & engineering folks?

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 2: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed Nov 3: 09:00–11:00 or 13:00–15:00

I've attached the latest redline (v3) so you can skim before we confirm. We also need the evidence matrix and an expected DocuSign timeline from your side.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

Alex Voss
Head of Procurement, Skyline Health

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the redline. Splitting makes sense and matches how we typically manage legal vs onboarding content.

Suggested cadence (we'll reserve separate invites):
1) MSA redline call — 30 min — Redwood legal + Skyline GC + LawBridge (if needed) — focused on open clauses and any high-risk bits.
2) Onboarding checkpoint — 60 min — procurement + engineering + CS onboarding lead to run through evidence, SSO, network/firewall, and initial runbook.

From the windows you suggested, we can do: Tue Nov 2 14:00–15:30 PST (30-min redline at 14:00, 60-min onboarding at 14:45 — back-to-back with a 15-minute buffer), or Wed Nov 3 09:00–11:00 PST (09:00 redline / 09:35 onboarding). Which do you prefer?

I'll attach our runbook and evidence matrix for their review. Marissa, Ben — can you lead the onboarding and evidence sections respectively if Alex confirms?

Attaching: redwood_onboard_runbook_v2.docx, evidence_matrix.csv

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[dylan.brooks@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123]

- SSO/SCIM integration checklist and expected dev effort
- Network/firewall requirements and IP allowlist guidance
- Billing contacts & initial invoicing cadence

Alex — either Tue Nov 2 14:00 PST or Wed Nov 3 09:00 PST works for us. If Tuesday is preferred we'll lock the 14:00 stack and share calendar invites + Zoom.

Best,
Marissa Cole
